payload.title: Create a Story from a Reference in one tap
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-02: a Create Story action on the Reference card and detail: one tap creates the Story (type article by default, stage copywriting), title from the Reference, body starts from its generated summary with source link and attribution, image from the Reference preview, uses_evidence link, opens in the article editor. Tapping again offers the existing Story. Branch feature/story-from-reference.
